SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF AUG-23-2021 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF AUG-23-2021 BY MICHELLE TONG. PLAINTIFF RAJAT SHAH IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT STEVEN BECKHAM IS PRESENT VIA UNAUTHORIZED TELEPHONE APPEARANCE BY CALLING COURTROOM PHONE NUMBER OF 415-551-3785. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. DEFENDANT PROVIDES HIS TELEPHONE NUMBER TO THE COURT. (SEE NOTES) COURT CALLS DEFENDANT AT THE NUMBER PROVIDED USING THE COURTCALL PHONE ON THE BENCH. COURT DISCUSSES APPEARANCE ISSUE WITH DEFENDANT. COURT INFORMS DEFENDANT THAT THE COURT DID NOT RECEIVE HIS REQUEST FOR ZOOM OR COURTCALL APPEARANCE TIMELY. DEFENDANT STATES THAT HE DOES NOT HAVE THE ABILITY TO APPEAR VIA ZOOM. DEFENDANT STATES THAT HE DOES NOT HAVE ACCESS TO A COMPUTER. COURT ALLOWS DEFENDANTS APPEARANCE BY TELEPHONE. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
